title: Telling Time Worksheets | K–1st Math Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 1.MD.B.3, K.MD.A.2

Give your learners extra practice with Telling Time! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Cover page
  • What Time Is It?
  • Clock Match
  • Clock Memory
  • Morning, Afternoon or Night?
  • One Hour Later
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
